module: An individual rally recce transcription: the recognized text of the co-driver's voice, its source, its timestamp and the vehicle data at the time of the phrase (position, orientation, and steering captures). Mainly used by the rally editor to display a 3D car in debug, color the trajectory according to the steering angle (corner call) and start a camera path. The module returns a constructor: `require(...)(path, name, forceId)`; the object is an element of `sortedList` (id, name, sortOrder).
notes: The vehicle_data field is a container: vehicle_data.vehicle_data contains {pos, quat} of the vehicle and vehicle_data.capture_data contains {captures, cornerAnglesStyle}; several methods (vehiclePos, vehicleQuat, capture_data) crash if vehicle_data is nil (before onDeserialized).

get_grouped_captures caches the result in grouped_captures and requires editor_rallyEditor (transcriptions window) to get the corner angles; without the editor, sortedAngles stays nil and rallyUtil.determineCornerCall has no list to iterate over.
rallyUtil.determineCornerCall returns nil if the steering falls in no range; the code then accesses cap.calc.angle_data.color without a test.
debugDrawText concatenates without a test: if text is nil and is_hovered, error.
Dimensions of the debug car: height 1.6 m, width 1.8 m, length 4.4 m; pos is assumed to be at the center of the car. Teal color, white on hover, light teal when selected.

C.desc: Transcription. Fields: path, id, name, sortOrder (999999), show (true), text, success, src, file, beamng_file, timestamp, vehicle_data, grouped_captures.

init.desc: Constructor: forced id or one provided by path:getNextUniqueIdentifier(), default name `t_<id>`, display enabled.

isUsable.desc: True if the transcription has vehicle data and is displayed.

debugDrawText.desc: Text displayed above the debug car: text, followed by "(click to copy)" on hover.

hovered.desc: true if the mouse hovers the entry.

vehiclePos.desc: Vehicle position at the time of the transcription.

returns.desc: World position, or nil if absent.

vehicleQuat.desc: Vehicle orientation at the time of the transcription.

get_grouped_captures.desc: Groups consecutive captures that have the same corner call (e.g. "3L", "C"). Sorts the angles of the chosen style, assigns them a red-yellow-green gradient (white for the center), computes for each capture a calc field {angle_pct, angle_data, cornerCallStr}, and sets a label point at the middle of each group. Result cached.

returns.desc: List of groups {captures, label_point, calc}; nil without capture_data.

onSerialize.desc: Returns {oldId, name, show, text, success, src, file, beamng_file, timestamp, vehicle_data}.

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the fields with default values (empty strings, 0.0, empty table). show is forced to false if the vehicle position is absent.

drawDebug.desc: Draws the debug car then, if hovered or selected, the steering captures.

drawDebugVehicleData.desc: Draws a stylized car (square prism + 4 wheel spheres) at the recorded position/orientation, with the transcription text.

drawDebugCaptureData.desc: For a hovered or selected entry: sphere of radius 0.5 colored by angle for each capture and corner call label per group.

playCameraPath.desc: Builds a camera path (1 m above each capture, FOV 60, time relative to the first ts, fixes the sign of the quaternions) and plays it via core_paths.playPath.

lookAtMe.desc: Centers the editor camera on the vehicle position (rallyUtil.setCameraTarget).
